entities.summary: The Bukit Tiban National Park is a national park in Bintulu Division, Sarawak, Malaysia. The park encloses the headwaters of the Sungai Nyalau and Sungai Timong rivers in the Miri Division and Sungai Sigrok, a tributary of Sungai Similajau in the Bintulu Division.
